feat: Sprint 10 — Smart Import + Philosophy Detection

Smart Import: AI-powered training program import from any file format.

services/philosophyDetection.ts, SmartImportView.vue,

feat: Sprint 11 — Real-time messaging system

Add 1-on-1 direct messaging with Supabase Realtime subscriptions.

Database: conversations + messages tables with RLS, unique pair index,
auto-updating last_message_at trigger, message-attachments storage bucket,
and realtime publication for live message delivery.

Frontend: MessagesView \(conversation list with "+" new message button and
user search modal with debounced search\), MessageThreadView \(full-screen
chat with message bubbles, date dividers, image/video attachments,
auto-scroll, and realtime updates\). Messages service layer handles
get/create conversations, send/mark-read, file upload, subscriptions,
and unread counts.

Navigation: TopHeader message icon wired up with unread badge \(30s poll\),
ProfileView and PublicProfileView "Message" buttons now create/find
conversations and navigate to thread. Message thread hides bottom nav
and top header for full-screen chat experience.
